headline: Boeing, Kratos To Build Skyborg Drones For Air Force Experiments
summary: Drone stocks Boeing and Kratos Defense & Security Solutions received Air Force awarded contracts for its Skyborg combat drone experiment. Boeing won a $25.7 million contract from the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center late Monday, Kratos a $37.7 million contract and privately held General Atomics a $14 million contract. The three companies have until May to deliver the drone prototypes to the Air Force so the service can perform flight tests ahead of expected experimentation events in July.
